resources.string: Hear Slack messages in Android Auto and reply when available
Copies of Slack messages, for Android Auto to read aloud.
Quiet Slack copies for the car
Silent copies with minimum importance. Android Auto may hide these.
Hide Flack copies on the phone
On by default. Copies stay in the silent section; Android cannot hide them fully. If the car stays empty, turn this off and receive a new Slack message. Changing this clears current copies.
Android Auto reads Flack\'s copy of each message, so Flack needs to post it.
This lets Flack see Slack messages. Flack sends nothing over the internet unless you sign in to Slack, and then it talks only to Slack.

Android protects this setting for apps installed outside Google Play.

1. Tap Open App info below.
2. Tap the menu (three dots) in the top corner.
3. Tap Allow restricted settings and confirm.
4. Come back and turn on notification access.
Let Flack run in the background
Samsung puts apps to sleep. Choose \"Allow\" or \"Unrestricted\" for Flack so messages keep coming while you drive.
Flack is not from Google Play, so Android Auto hides it until you turn on \"Unknown sources\".

This is Android Auto's own developer mode, separate from your phone's developer options.

1. Open Settings, then Connected devices, then Android Auto. On Samsung, if App info opens, tap Configure in Android Auto.
2. Scroll down and tap the Version row 10 times, until it asks to allow development settings. Accept the prompt.
3. Open the menu (three dots), then Developer settings.
4. Turn on Unknown sources.

If Android Auto or Gemini offers a setting to send replies automatically, turn it off, so you hear every reply before it is sent.
Android Auto is not installed on this phone.
Forward Slack messages to Android Auto
Only while Android Auto is connected
Keeps copies off your phone the rest of the day. Turn off to test without a car.
Copied. Paste it into a device test result on GitHub. It contains no message text.

Optional. Sign in so Flack can post your car replies as you when a Slack notification has no reply button. Flack asks Slack to let it post messages as you, search your messages to find the one a notification is about, and read names to check it found the right one. It reads nothing else. This version signs in only; replies through sign-in come in a later version.
Slack sign-in is not set up in this build.
Sign out of %1$s? Flack asks Slack to end this sign-in and deletes it from the phone.
No browser could open Slack\'s sign-in page.
Signed in to %1$s. Slack could not confirm the end of the earlier sign-in for this workspace. Flack tries again when you sign out. To end it now, remove Flack from that workspace\'s apps in Slack.
Slack did not finish signing in. If your workspace needs an admin to approve Flack, ask them to approve it, then tap Add a Slack workspace again.
Sign-in was interrupted. Tap Add a Slack workspace to try again.

Flack could not confirm the sign-in with Slack, and Slack may have finished it without Flack. Check your connection and try again. To end a sign-in that Flack does not list, remove Flack from that workspace\'s apps in Slack.
Slack refused the sign-in. Try again, and allow every permission Flack asks for.
Flack could not save the sign-in on this phone. Try again.
Flack could not finish signing in, and Slack could not confirm that the sign-in was cancelled. To end it now, remove Flack from that workspace\'s apps in Slack. Then try again.
Flack could not read your Slack sign-in right now. Close Flack and open it again. Your sign-in is kept.
Flack could not update the sign-in for %1$s on this phone. Try again.
Removed %1$s from this phone. Slack could not confirm the sign-out, so it may stay active until it expires. To end it now, remove Flack from that workspace\'s apps in Slack.
Flack %1$s · Independent app. Not affiliated with Slack, Google or Samsung.\nForwards new messages only. Message text stays in memory and is never saved.
